items.text: -ms-align-items is not a real CSS property in any IE/Edge version; IE10 uses -ms-flex-align (already on line 120). Dead output
align-items mixin body indented 4 spaces while the other new mixins use 2, breaching CONTRIBUTING.md 'two spaces' and .editorconfig indent_size=2
`-ms-align-items` on line 121 is not a valid CSS property (the correct `-ms-flex-align` is already on line 120, making this dead code)

Mixins pass values straight through to legacy properties: -webkit-box-align/-ms-flex-align need start/end not flex-start/flex-end, and -webkit-box-ordinal-group must be >=1, so future align-items(flex-start) or order(0) calls emit invalid legacy CSS
-webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group require values starting from 1, not 0. If $val is 0, this will cause incorrect rendering in older browsers, leading to layout issues.

The mobile rule `.small-action .custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` was tuned for old `padding-left: 4em` on `.small-action-desc`, but the patch changes that padding to `0 1.5%` and makes `.small-action` a flex container. This causes the custom message to be pulled about 40px left over the `.topic-avatar` icon or past the left edge, and the mobile stylesheet was left untouched.
Commit 5b229316ee message is a summary line only, no body, while it also changes small-action spacing and badge margins, contrary to CONTRIBUTING.md commit section
align-items:$alignment; lacks a space after the colon
clearfix on .contents is now dead weight; its ::before/::after (display:table) become empty flex items, a trap if justify-content:space-between is added later
Third-party themes/plugins relying on .d-header .title {float:left} / .panel {float:right} or adding floated children to .contents will change layout because floats are ignored in a flex container

Legacy flexbox order off-by-one error: -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group use 1-based indexing while modern order uses 0-based indexing, causing mis-ordering in older WebKit and Firefox browsers when passing $val directly to legacy properties
.small-action.time-gap .topic-avatar { margin-top: -5px } now shifts the clock icon 5px above centre under align-items:center

The `order` mixin passes `$val` directly to `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` and `-moz-box-ordinal-group`, but these legacy properties use 1-based indexing while CSS `order` is 0-based — the mixin should pass `$val + 1` for correct behavior
Mobile override .small-action-desc p { padding-top: 0 } is now dead since the patch removed the base p { padding-top: 4px } it cancelled
The order mixin and both order() calls could be replaced by moving the header-extra-info block above .panel in header.hbs; CSS reordering also makes Tab order differ from visual order

Replacing .small-action-desc padding 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em with 0 1.5% leaves the untouched mobile override .small-action .custom-message { margin-left: -40px } pulling the custom message ~40px left over the now-adjacent .topic-avatar icon

The mobile rule `.small-action.time-gap .topic-avatar { margin-top: -5px }` (lines 530-532) was tuned for the old float layout. With the new `align-items: center` on `.small-action`, it shifts the time-gap clock icon 5px above centre.

`.contents` in header.hbs still has the `clearfix` class, whose `::before`/`::after` pseudo-elements become unnecessary flex items when the container is `display: flex` — the `clear: both` on `::after` is a no-op in flex context

.small-action is now a flex container and .small-action-desc a flex item without flex-grow, so it shrink-wraps its text; the float:right edit/delete buttons inside it now sit next to the text instead of at the right edge of the row

Making .d-header .contents a flex container breaks long-title handling in the docked desktop header: the extra-info flex item keeps min-width:auto / default flex-shrink, so a long nowrap .topic-link no longer ellipsizes and either squeezes .panel until its floated icons wrap inside the fixed 60px header, or pushes .panel past the right edge
-ms-align-items never existed in any version of IE/Edge; the correct legacy property is -ms-flex-align.

@include order(2) on .extra-info-wrapper is ineffective/redundant: .extra-info-wrapper is not itself a flex item (it sits inside the header-extra-info ember-view), and visual order comes out right solely because .panel has order(3)
-ms-align-items is not a recognized MS flexbox property (IE10/11 use -ms-flex-align instead), keeping it emits invalid CSS declarations and makes debugging harder
float:left on .small-action .topic-avatar is now dead because floats are ignored on flex items

In the 2009 display:-webkit-box model (Safari 5.1, Android <=4.3, iOS <=6) auto margins are not honoured, so margin-left:auto on .panel no longer right-aligns it, and the float:right fallback was removed

For legacy -webkit-box/-moz-box flexbox syntax, *-box-ordinal-group is 1-based (whereas modern order is 0-based), so using $val directly can shift ordering by 1 in older browsers - need to offset the *-box-ordinal-group value
'All prefixes' is incomplete: align-items() emits no -moz-box-align although flexbox() emits display:-moz-box, so old-box-model Firefox stretches instead of centring
Keep paragraph spacing inside `.custom-message`; zeroing `p` margins collapses multi-paragraph cooked messages into one block.

Mobile layout regression: The padding on `.small-action-desc` changed from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` to `0 1.5%`, but `mobile/topic-post.scss:521` still has `margin-left: -40px` on `.custom-message`. That negative margin was designed to offset the old ~64px left padding; with only ~4.8px of padding on a 320px mobile viewport, the custom-message now overflows ~35px past the left edge of its container

No-ember header right-align broken: The PR changes .panel alignment to rely on flexbox (margin-left:auto/order), but the Rails fallback header wraps .panel inside a Bootstrap v2 .row which is float-based (not a flex container). Therefore .panel is not a flex item in that path and will no longer right-align on noscript and /no_ember pages.
The align-items mixin emits `-ms-align-items` which no browser implements - this is dead output. IE10 reads `-ms-flex-align` which is already emitted on line 120.
Trailing whitespace after -ms-flex-align: $alignment;

order mixin ordinal-group off-by-one: The order mixin passes $val directly to -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group, but the old flexbox spec uses 1-based indexing (default: 1) while the standard order property is 0-based (default: 0). This causes incorrect element ordering in older browsers.

Mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. Further this PR removes the float-based right alignment for .d-header .panel, which may cause the login panel in the non-Ember/noscript header (where .panel is nested inside .row and not a flex item) to stack under the title instead of remaining right-aligned.

Scope creep: commit message says 'adding flexbox to header' but the patch also re-lays out .small-action (post-stream action rows) and rewrites its spacing, contrary to CONTRIBUTING.md one-feature-per-branch

`@include order(2)` on `.extra-info-wrapper` (topic.scss:29) is dead CSS because `.extra-info-wrapper` is a grandchild of the flex container (Ember wraps `header-extra-info` in a `div.ember-view`), and `order` only applies to direct children

The `align-items` mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which is not a valid vendor-prefixed CSS property. The correct IE prefix is `-ms-flex-align` (already present in the mixin). The invalid `-ms-align-items` line in the mixin should be removed to avoid confusion.
This removes the only right-alignment rule for the ERB header's `.panel`; `margin-left: auto` only works when `.panel` is a flex item, but `_header.html.erb` nests it inside `.row`.

Adding flexbox to `.small-action` while its children (`.topic-avatar`, `.avatar`, `button`) still use `float: left`/`float: right` is contradictory — floats are ignored on flex items. These float declarations should be removed or replaced with flex-based alignment (e.g., `margin-left: auto` on the button) to avoid unexpected layout results.

issues.claim: The align-items mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which is not a real CSS property in any IE/Edge version. IE10/11 use `-ms-flex-align`, which the mixin already emits on line 120, so the `-ms-align-items` line is dead output.
The align-items mixin body is indented 4 spaces, while the other new mixins use 2. This conflicts with CONTRIBUTING.md and .editorconfig indent_size=2.

The mixins pass values unchanged to legacy properties. `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align` need start/end rather than flex-start/flex-end, so a call like align-items(flex-start) would emit invalid legacy CSS.

The order mixin passes `$val` directly to `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` and `-moz-box-ordinal-group`. Those legacy properties are 1-based, while `order` is 0-based, so ordering in older WebKit/Firefox is off by one, and a value of 0 is invalid.

`.small-action-desc` padding changed from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` to `0 1.5%`, but the mobile rule `.small-action .custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` (mobile/topic-post.scss) was not updated. The custom message is now pulled about 40px left, over the `.topic-avatar` icon or past the container's left edge.

The message of commit 5b229316ee has only a summary line and no body, even though the commit also changes small-action spacing and badge margins. This is contrary to the commit section of CONTRIBUTING.md.
`align-items:$alignment;` has no space after the colon.

`.contents` in header.hbs still has the `clearfix` class. Now that it is a flex container, the clearfix `::before`/`::after` pseudo-elements become empty flex items and the `clear: both` has no effect.

Third-party themes or plugins that rely on `.d-header .title {float:left}` or `.panel {float:right}`, or that add floated children to `.contents`, will change layout, because floats are ignored inside the flex container.

The mobile rule `.small-action.time-gap .topic-avatar { margin-top: -5px }` was tuned for the float layout. Under the new `align-items: center` on `.small-action`, it shifts the time-gap clock icon 5px above centre.
The mobile override `.small-action-desc p { padding-top: 0 }` is now dead, because the patch removed the base `p { padding-top: 4px }` it was cancelling.
The order mixin and both order() calls could be replaced by moving the header-extra-info block above .panel in header.hbs. Reordering with CSS makes Tab order differ from visual order.

`.small-action` is now a flex container and `.small-action-desc` is a flex item without flex-grow, so it shrink-wraps its text. The float:right edit/delete buttons inside it now sit next to the text instead of at the right edge of the row.

Making `.d-header .contents` a flex container breaks long-title handling in the docked desktop header. The extra-info flex item keeps min-width:auto and the default flex-shrink, so a long nowrap `.topic-link` no longer ellipsizes. It either squeezes .panel until its icons wrap inside the 60px header or pushes .panel past the right edge.

`@include order(2)` on `.extra-info-wrapper` (topic.scss:29) has no effect. `.extra-info-wrapper` is a grandchild of the flex container, inside the header-extra-info ember-view div, and `order` only applies to direct children.

`.small-action` is now a flex container, yet its children (`.topic-avatar`, `.avatar`, `button`) still use `float: left`/`float: right`. Floats are ignored on flex items, so these declarations, such as float:left on `.topic-avatar`, are dead.

In the 2009 `display:-webkit-box` model (Safari 5.1, Android <=4.3, iOS <=6), auto margins are not honoured. With the float:right fallback removed, `margin-left:auto` on .panel no longer right-aligns it.
The align-items() mixin emits no `-moz-box-align`, although flexbox() emits `display:-moz-box`. Old-box-model Firefox therefore stretches items instead of centring them.
Zeroing `p` margins inside `.custom-message` removes paragraph spacing, so multi-paragraph cooked messages collapse into one block.

The PR removes the float-based right alignment of `.d-header .panel` and relies on `margin-left: auto`/order. In the ERB/no-ember/noscript header (`_header.html.erb`), `.panel` is nested inside a float-based Bootstrap `.row` and is not a flex item, so it no longer right-aligns.
There is trailing whitespace after `-ms-flex-align: $alignment;`.

The commit message says 'adding flexbox to header', but the patch also re-lays out `.small-action` post-stream rows and rewrites their spacing. This is contrary to the one-feature-per-branch rule in CONTRIBUTING.md.
